Internet Shutdown, Protests at Jantar Mantar Spark Legal and Media Scrutiny

Mobile internet services were suspended around Jantar Mantar and Connaught Place in Delhi, with liquor shops ordered to close by 8 pm over a weekend, amid protests. A Public Interest Litigation (PIL) was filed in the Delhi High Court challenging the internet shutdown and seeking its publication. Police took action against objectionable posts targeting the Prime Minister following the protests. Separately, a truck carrying stones was reported near a protest site, with media outlets investigating its presence and purpose.
